title: Refill Log
content: The Refill Log page gives you a complete view of every LN2 top-up across all containers — tank status, reservoir inventory, and a full activity history.

title: Open Refill Log
content: Click here to open the Refill Log page.

title: Refill Detected
content: The system automatically detects when a container has been refilled based on sensor data. Each card here represents a pending detection waiting for your review — confirm or dismiss it to keep the log accurate.

title: Detection Card
content: This card shows a refill detected for container T-161 in Bangalore on 21/04/26 at 08:15 AM — 5.2 kg of LN2 added. Click Add Log to convert this detection into a confirmed refill record.

title: Add Log
content: Click here to open the Add Log form for this detection.

title: Add Log Form
content: The form is pre-filled from the detection — tank T-161, Bangalore reservoir, date and time, and 5.2 kg refill weight. Set who performed the refill and add any notes before saving.

title: Save the Log
content: Click Save to confirm the refill and add it to the activity log.

title: Recent Activity Log
content: Every refill event — who performed it, when, how much LN2 was added, and any notes — is recorded here. This is your complete audit trail for compliance and maintenance reviews.

title: Active Tank Status
content: Every active container and its current LN2 level is listed here. Tanks approaching the minimum threshold are flagged so refills can be scheduled before a critical alert fires.

title: Tank T-11 — Tambaram
content: Each row shows the container code, branch, current LN2 level against the L2 threshold, and days since the last refill. Click View to inspect the full refill history for this container.

title: View Refill History
content: Click View to open the refill history for tank T-11.

title: Refill History
content: This panel shows the complete refill log for the selected container — last refill date, who performed it, quantity added, reservoir used, and current status. Use this to audit and track maintenance for each tank.

title: Close
content: Close the refill history panel to return to the main view.

title: Reservoir Logs
content: Track bulk LN2 orders and deliveries for each branch reservoir. Ordered and received dates are logged here to keep your supply chain transparent and auditable.

title: Bangalore Reservoir
content: This entry shows the LN2 ordered on 2026-04-20 for the Bangalore Reservoir — but the received date is still missing. Update it once the delivery arrives to keep the record complete.

title: Edit Reservoir Log
content: Click the edit icon to fill in the missing received date.

title: LN2 Received Date
content: The received date has been filled in as 2026-04-25. This completes the order record and keeps your reservoir inventory accurate.

title: Save
content: Click to save the received date and update the Bangalore Reservoir log.

title: Reservoir Logs
content: The Bangalore Reservoir log is now updated with the received date. Every bulk LN2 order and delivery for each branch is tracked here — keeping your supply chain fully auditable.

title: Reservoir Tank Visualizer
content: This panel shows the current LN2 level for the selected branch reservoir. The fill level updates in real time — use the dropdown below to switch between branch reservoirs.

title: Switch Reservoir
content: Click the branch selector below the tank to view a different reservoir's LN2 level.

title: Select Delhi
content: All branch reservoirs are listed here. Click Delhi to load its current LN2 level into the visualizer.

title: Delhi Reservoir
content: The Delhi reservoir is currently at 62% capacity — 154.4 kg of LN2 out of a 250 kg maximum. Monitor this panel regularly to schedule top-ups before levels drop below the minimum threshold.
